goal: Prevent wallet transaction creation from failing with cryptic errors in very large clusters
Provide clear user-facing errors when spending unconfirmed coins whose fee calculation fails
agreement: Neutral sentiment with objections addressed but no explicit approvals yet

why: P3 because it replaces a cryptic RPC crash with a clear error message in rare mempool conditions
